names.form: Άγιοι Μάρκος, Αρίσταρχος και Ζήνων οι Απόστολοι από τους Εβδομήκοντα

names.note: Read out of «Άγιοι Μάρκος, Αρίσταρχος και Ζήνων οι Απόστολοι από τους Εβδομήκοντα» in this folder’s Greek citation.
Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 15 aprilie, «Sfântul Apostol Aristarh».

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru’s page for 27 сентября ст. ст. (civil 10 October) was not read (2026-09-17).

feast.note: The Romanian calendar keeps him on 15 April, with Pudens and Trophimus; the Greek synaxarion this folder already cited keeps him on 27 September and repeats his memory on 14 April.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 15 aprilie — «Sfântul Apostol Aristarh»

hymns.text: Sfinţilor Apostoli rugaţi pe Milostivul Dumnezeu, ca să dea iertare de greşeli sufletelor noastre.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfinților Apostoli Aristarh, Pud, Trofim», Glasul 3

english.text: O holy apostles, entreat the merciful God to grant our souls forgiveness of sins.
